Noto Sans CJK TC Medium is the unmodified Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) OpenType
font from the Noto Sans CJK 2.004 release. TextMesh Pro uses it as a dynamic
fallback for characters outside the kitchen UI's existing font.

Source
https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk/blob/523d033d6cb47f4a80c58a35753646f5c3608a78/Sans/OTF/TraditionalChinese/NotoSansCJKtc-Medium.otf

SHA-256 2905dd3de65d7b7de764596e2294978407986f4cc0a66c9584c5b95c5aa9572e
